description: This line plot, titled “Performance w.r.t. Temperature,” illustrates the accuracy of three different methods—On-policy RL, LUFFY, and SFT—as a function of temperature, ranging from 0.1 to 1.0 on the x-axis labeled “Temperature.” The y-axis, labeled “Accuracy (Pass@8)”, scales linearly from 62.5 to 80.0. The plot displays three distinct lines: the On-policy RL method is represented by an orange line with triangle markers; the LUFFY method is shown as a red line with star markers; and the SFT method is depicted by a teal line with triangle markers. The On-policy RL line starts at approximately 64.5 at temperature 0.1, rises to about 73.0 at temperature 0.5, then drops to around 66.5 at temperature 0.7 before increasing again to about 73.0 at temperature 1.0. The LUFFY line begins at approximately 76.0 at temperature 0.1, peaks at around 80.0 at temperature 0.8, and ends near 80.0 at temperature 1.0. The SFT line starts at approximately 75.0 at temperature 0.1, dips to around 71.0 at temperature 0.5, then rises to about 74.0 at temperature 1.0.
